latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Customer Lifetime Value Growth skill.
- Provides a step-by-step process for small businesses to increase Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) using five levers: raising prices, point-of-purchase upsells, ascension ladders, increasing purchase frequency, and winning back lapsed customers.
- Includes clear input requirements (business description, transaction value, customer list, and current pricing).
- Guides users in calculating current CLV and auditing all five growth levers with actionable recommendations.
- Designed for businesses aiming to grow revenue from existing customers without relying on new customer acquisition.
